exemptions.reason: Algoma Central (Sault Ste. Marie to Hearst), Ontario Northland, the Gaspe railway, QNS&L (Sept-Iles to Schefferville) and CN's Soo Subdivision are coded passenger by BTS NARN, have no passenger route relation in OSM and are no agency operator. Kept as passenger by decision of the user, 2026-10-16, although some services are suspended.
VIA Rail trains (The Canadian, Sudbury - White River, Jasper - Prince Rupert) run on these CPKC and CN subdivisions; OSM has no passenger route on them. NARN codes 90 to 100% passenger.
